mapper.sql: select u.user_id as userId, u.tenant_id as tenantId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, u.phonenumber, u.email, u.status, u.remark, u.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, p.primary_company_id as companyId, p.is_default_installer_admin as isDefaultInstallerAdmin, c.company_name as companyName, group_concat(distinct r.role_name order by r.role_sort separator ' / ') as roleNames from sys_user u inner join ems_user_profile p on p.user_id = u.user_id left join ems_company c on c.id = p.primary_company_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id and r.del_flag = '0' and left(r.role_key, 4) = 'ems_' where u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: group by u.user_id, u.tenant_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, u.email, u.status, u.remark, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, p.primary_company_id, p.is_default_installer_admin, c.company_name order by u.user_id desc

group by u.user_id, u.tenant_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, u.email, u.status, u.remark, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, p.primary_company_id, p.is_default_installer_admin, c.company_name order by u.user_id desc

and u.user_id = #{userId}
group by u.user_id, u.tenant_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, u.email, u.status, u.remark, u.dept_id, d.dept_name, p.primary_company_id, p.is_default_installer_admin, c.company_name limit 1
